description: Scans a GitHub repository for malicious patterns (backdoors, data exfiltration, supply-chain attacks, known-bad packages) BEFORE cloning or installing it. The verdict is pinned to the repository's current commit SHA. Call this before cloning any untrusted repository.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit to scan (default: default branch)

tarball.description: Read the whole commit in one request instead of one request per file. Reads far more of a large repository (facebook/react: 4,373 files against 226) and spends 6 requests against GitHub's rate limit instead of 231, so an unauthenticated scan can finish. Off by default: at that coverage the rules also fire on test fixtures and vendored bundles, which moved 10 of 50 well-known repositories off a low verdict. coverage.readMode in the result says which reader ran.

target.description: GitHub repository URL or owner/repo slug, e.g. https://github.com/acme/repo

name: scan_github_repo
title: Scan a GitHub repository for malware
